course_topics_pages_chk.name: course_topics_pages_chk
course_topics_pages_chk.value: "course_topics"."page_start" is null or "course_topics"."page_end" is null or "course_topics"."page_end" >= "course_topics"."page_start"

tutor_location_chk.name: tutor_location_chk
tutor_location_chk.value:
"tutor_profiles"."onboarding_completed_at" is null or "tutor_profiles"."teaching_mode" = 'online'
				or ("tutor_profiles"."postcode" is not null and "tutor_profiles"."travel_radius_km" is not null)

student_location_chk.name: student_location_chk
student_location_chk.value: "student_profiles"."onboarding_completed_at" is null or "student_profiles"."delivery_preference" = 'online' or "student_profiles"."postcode" is not null
